creator: OpenAI Codex for the Tien Nghich 2D audio pilot
brief: An original quiet courtyard return, with a muted string answering a breath tone over a sustained D/A fifth. Space between phrases leaves room for short UI and reward cues.
rights: Original score and procedural instrument patches authored for this project. All audio is synthesized locally. No third-party samples, recordings, MIDI or soundfonts were incorporated.
route: Explicit note data and deterministic additive/noise synthesis. No audited, locally available FluidSynth and licensed SF2 pair was identified.
catalog_check: AssetCat 1.0.2, scoped fixture project/ember-delta-qa. Soundfont search returned no matches. Project/Ember Delta QA/ash-check.wav is a setup fixture, excluded. Its license and AI status are unknown, with no license file or AI reason recorded.

rebuild.prng: NumPy PCG64, instrument seed 173521, room seed 173522
rebuild.evidence: Two separate processes rendered into empty output directories. Both files matched the delivered WAV byte for byte.

music.tuning: A4 = 440 Hz. The D3/A3 drone oscillators round to whole cycles over 72 seconds for continuous phase.

master.encoding: RIFF/WAVE PCM signed 16-bit little-endian, interleaved L/R
master.marker_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
master.tail: Final bar has no new pluck or breath attacks. The drone continues and circular stereo reflections carry the decay into bar one.

qa.waveform_seam: Three contiguous passes. At each join the successive L/R changes in PCM counts are [97,95], [96,96] at the boundary, then [97,96]. No frames added or removed.
qa.human_listening: Pending three-pass stereo master and decoded derivative auditions, and matched monitoring with the pilot effects.
